title: Northbridge Specialty Pharmacy Delivery Standards for the Specialty Pharmacy Program
content:
Northbridge Specialty Pharmacy ships Specialty Pharmacy Program fills under the delivery standards below. The table covers every tier.

## Refrigerated drugs

On every tier, Humira, adalimumab-adaz, Dupixent, Skyrizi and Enbrel ship refrigerated.

## Delivery terms by tier

| Tier | Refill reminder call (days before the supply runs out) | Refill scheduled at least (business days before delivery) | Adult signature required on delivery | Delivery to the prescriber's office for in-office administration | Free sharps container with injectable therapies |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Northbridge Specialty Open Access | 7 | 3 | No | Allowed | Yes |
| Northbridge Specialty Preferred | 7 | 3 | No | Allowed | Yes |
| Northbridge Specialty Exclusive | 7 | 3 | No | Allowed | Yes |
| Northbridge Specialty Exclusive with Copay Assist | 7 | 3 | No | Allowed | Yes |
| Northbridge Specialty Care Management | 10 | 2 | Yes | Allowed | Yes |
| Northbridge Specialty Total Care | 10 | 2 | Yes | Allowed | Yes |

## Delivery problems and free reshipment

- The **reporting window** is the number of calendar days after the scheduled delivery date within which a missed, damaged or temperature-compromised delivery must be reported for a free reshipment. The scheduled delivery date is day zero.
- The **reshipment allowance** is the number of free reshipments for missed or damaged deliveries per enrollment per plan year. Temperature excursions caused by the carrier never count against it.

| Tier | Reporting window (calendar days after the scheduled delivery date) | Free reshipments for missed or damaged deliveries per enrollment per plan year |
|---|---|---|
| Northbridge Specialty Open Access | 5 | 1 |
| Northbridge Specialty Preferred | 5 | 1 |
| Northbridge Specialty Exclusive | 7 | 2 |
| Northbridge Specialty Exclusive with Copay Assist | 7 | 2 |
| Northbridge Specialty Care Management | 7 | 2 |
| Northbridge Specialty Total Care | 10 | 3 |

*Illustration (assumed date):* for a delivery scheduled for May 4, the reporting window is counted from May 4 as day zero. On Northbridge Specialty Open Access the window reaches day 5 on May 9. On Northbridge Specialty Total Care it reaches day 10 on May 14.
